(Capacity: 15,596) |champion= [[SoCal Challenge]] Surf Division Champions |tourney= [[2022 The Basketball Classic|The Basketball Classic]] Champions }} {{2021–22 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Fresno]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bulldogs were led by fourth-year head coach [[Justin Hutson]] and played their home games at the [[Save Mart Center]] as members of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2019–20 Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 12–12, 9–11 in [[2020–21 Mountain West Conference basketball season|Mountain West play]] to finish in sixth place.{{Cite web|title=2020-21 Fresno State Bulldogs Schedule and Results|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/fresno-state/2021-schedule.html|access-date=2021-10-12|website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|language=en}} They defeated [[2020–21 New Mexico Lobos men's basketball team|New Mexico]] in the first round{{Cite web|title=New Mexico vs. Fresno State - Game Recap - March 10, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401286993|access-date=2021-10-12|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} of the [[2021 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Colorado State Rams men's basketball team|Colorado State]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite web|title=Fresno State vs. Colorado State - Game Recap - March 11, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401286998|access-date=2021-10-12|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
